text:
sophie: hey folks, i'm sophie (new infra eng) 👋 trying to get set up. i can't access Grafana dashboards or Datadog - Okta redirects then says 'You are not authorized'. who handles the observability grants?

alejandro: welcome sophie :tada: — i usually do the Datadog/Grafana adds for infra folks. can you paste your okta email? also check spam for any invites.

sophie: sophie.liu@redwood.com. nothing in spam. Grafana direct link also ends in 403 after SSO.

identity-bot: identity-bot created ticket IDP-3348 for sophie.liu@redwood.com: "Entitlement mapping missing for Redwood Datadog and Grafana". Assigned to: alejandro.

ida: cc @alejandro for Sentry access — security approval required for org membership. if you need error-level alerts for your service include the repo name in the request.

alejandro: thanks. opened INFRA-729: add sophie to team inference-observability and Grafana viewers. infra-bot will send invites. ETA 8h.

infra-bot: infra-bot sent Grafana invite to sophie.liu@redwood.com (expires 7 days). Pending Datadog team add.

sophie: received Grafana invite, accepted, can view most infra dashboards. not seeing 'inference-costs' folder though. search doesn't return it.

alejandro: permissions note: some folders are restricted. i'll add you to the folder ACL for infra. if it's still missing, let me know which dashboard name.

sophie: dashboard name seen in the onboarding doc: "infra/inference-costs". also there's a p95-by-model dashboard i need for the agent perf work.

alejandro: granted folder view ACL. check again. Datadog still pending because identity team needs to sync the team membership.

identity-bot: identity-bot: Datadog team add queued (IDP-3348 -> step: sync to Datadog). Expected completion: 4h.

sophie: Datadog shows up now! i can view monitors and the cost dashboard. small follow-up: how do i get alerting notifications routed to my pager?

ida: for paging you need to be in the escalation policy in PagerDuty. file a request in the support-systems board with justification and service name. if it's on-call rotation for infra, we'll add you after a short onboarding runbook review.

sophie: great, thanks. one more: are dashboard definitions stored in a repo? would like to submit a tweak to the p95-by-model graph (reduce time window default).

alejandro: yes, repo: platform/infra/grafana/dashboards. prefer PRs for changes. small edits that are not urgent can be made through PR + review. if it's an emergency change to an alert, ping on-call and create an RFC.

sophie: perfect, will open a PR. thanks everyone for the speedy help :heart:

alejandro: welcome aboard! added a note to the new-hire checklist: Grafana invites usually <1h, Datadog team sync may take up to 4h depending on identity sync. Sentry requires security approval and 2FA.
